title: Randomized prospective evaluation of the use of tranexamic acid and effects on blood loss for proximal humeral fracture surgery
journal: Journal of Shoulder and Elbow Surgery
design_evidence: Randomized prospective evaluation; A total of 101 patients were randomized to receive either a single preoperative dose of intravenous TXA (53 patients) or a control dose of saline solution (48 patients)
population: Patients with proximal humeral fractures who underwent surgical treatment (ORIF or arthroplasty) between April 2015 and April 2019
